item.tib: ma cig srid rgyal nag mo'i mthu sgrub kyi las mtha' zlog gzhung byad ma 'bum bsgrol
item.coloph: de ltar drag po'i gtor zlog 'dis/ mi bzlog mi 'jom gang yang med/ phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chod bzlog rig drug bar do'i sdug bsngal 'joms/ dam ldan skyes bus nyams su longs/ 'gro ba yongs la phan par shog skal med rnams la gsang rgya tham/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung bzhin/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin pos/ yi ge ris su bkod pa dge sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
